summary: Radar for 27 Nov 2026, all GLP-1. Thanksgiving peaks today. The 20:00 holiday slot ends after tonight, so the next seasonal hook is Christmas dinner on tirzepatide. The UK press is already running it (GB News reflux piece, LADbible), US outlets are only on general holiday tips, and demand should build from about 1 Dec to a peak around 18–26 Dec. That is the top early long-form opportunity. The biggest regulatory signal is the NAION eye warning. The FDA's 9 Nov class-wide warning covers all 12 US GLP-1 products (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, orforglipron). Canada piled on from 25–26 Nov (CBC, Globe and Mail, Global News "How rare is very rare?"). It is now peaking in Canada. Our angle is how rare it is and which symptoms need same-day care, kept separate from the Serious Risks video. The fresh studies are mostly observational or reviews (cancer umbrella review, breast density, sperm quality), so they suit chapters, not Shorts. Retatrutide sleep apnea (TRIUMPH-OSA, up to 60.6% fewer events at 80 weeks) is a pipeline result about 2 weeks old. It is past the 48 h fast-turn window, so it gets a long video only with a careful "not approved" framing. The search-demand formats remain the core: what-to-expect timelines (tirzepatide after 6 months, from the queue), device how-tos (Ozempic/Wegovy pen from the IFU, since the Mounjaro pen video already exists), head-to-heads (Foundayo vs Wegovy pill vs tirzepatide, with the Wegovy pill launching in Sweden on 24 Dec as a hook), and felt symptoms (nausea, hair, injection site, skin tingling). Already live or made, so never re-make: Mounjaro vs Ozempic (SURPASS-2), Foundayo What to Expect, Foundayo and Sleep Apnea, Zepbound vial vs pen, Months 2–6, the Pen how-to, Hair Loss, Constipation, Stopping and Keeping Results. Those go to Shorts, chapters or retitles only. Rejected: compounded recalls, "cheapest tirzepatide online" lists, needle-free peptide patches, counterfeit and peptide seizures, and "cut-price reta". Sources: [Benefits and Pensions Monitor on the FDA NAION warning](https://www.benefitsandpensionsmonitor.com/news/industry-news/us-fda-adds-the-glp-1-eye-risk-warning-canada-already-requires/394418), [Global News](https://globalnews.ca/news/12144337/glp1-vision-loss-warning-fda/), [Healio TRIUMPH-OSA](https://www.healio.com/news/pulmonology/20261111/triumphosa-retatrutide-reduces-sleep-apnea-severity-in-osa-plus-obesity), [Medical Daily retatrutide OSA](https://www.medicaldaily.com/retatrutide-sleep-apnea-trial-results-481297), [GB News Mounjaro Christmas](https://www.gbnews.com/health/mounjaro-christmas-lunch-side-effects-acid-reflux), [Drugs.com holiday tips](https://www.drugs.com/news/glp-1-here-s-tips-holiday-eating-122520.html).

Explain why fat-heavy festive foods feel worse with slower stomach emptying, give 3 small moves (smaller plate first, protein first, pause before seconds) and set a calm expectation: a holiday pause in weight loss is normal. It must not repeat the Thanksgiving video. Use a new chapter structure around the full day (Christmas morning, the big lunch, Boxing Day leftovers). No dose-skipping advice. End with 'talk to your prescriber'.

Publishing in early December lets the video rank before the peak in high-value UK, AU and US markets.

candidates.topic: Ozempic and Wegovy eye warning (NAION): Health Canada's new semaglutide warning and the FDA's class-wide label change. How rare is it, and which vision changes need same-day care?
candidates.angle: Calm and number-first. The FDA warning (9 Nov) covers all US GLP-1s. Report the meta-analysis rate (about 6.4 vs 3.8 per 100,000 person-years) as an absolute risk. Say exactly which symptom matters (sudden, painless vision loss in one eye means same-day care) and to keep taking the medicine unless your prescriber says otherwise, with no stop or switch advice. As a long video it is semaglutide-led, so it doesn't duplicate tirzepatide Serious Risks. For Shorts, use only the felt-moment form ('Blurry vision on Ozempic, is this normal?'), never a bare news item.

candidates.why_now: Health Canada's warning (25–26 Nov) got wall-to-wall Canadian coverage (CBC, Globe and Mail, Global News, Radio-Canada). Bloomberg reported that the drugs will carry a warning label. The FDA class-wide warning came on 9 Nov. Label changes are a 10×+ search format in this niche, and NAION reached 648 views on TikTok.
